items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Library, replay CLI, REPLAY report with every stop-1 input; deviations (own T-spec reader, deferred runtime ids) disclosed.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unreadable git/manifest/test files and a missing merge base fail closed; a broken PR is reported, not fatal.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No secrets; replay env scrubs token variables and workdir must be outside the repo; probes use a throwaway worktree.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 50 in-process tests on real git and a real coverage database, asserting outcomes, including fail-closed producers.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Replay of 100 PRs takes minutes; per-file reads are cached; noted batching as follow-up.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: All new files under 300 lines, sibling _baseline_touch_* modules, ruff clean.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Consumes coverage DB (round-trip probed with a real CoverageData file) and git output; no serialized format changed.
